title: Strategy Consulting Intern
description: Join our strategy practice for a 6-month internship. You will support senior consultants on strategic transformation projects for CAC 40 clients. Responsibilities include market research, financial analysis and Excel modelling, preparing PowerPoint presentations, and contributing to client proposals. Strong analytical skills and project management mindset required. Excel, PowerPoint, strategy, financial analysis, problem-solving and presentation skills are essential. English and French fluency required. Background in business or management welcomed.

title: Business Analyst Intern — Strategy & Operations
description: 6-month internship within our Strategy & Operations team. You will analyse business performance, build KPI dashboards in Excel, and support management consulting projects across retail and FMCG sectors. Key tasks: market research, competitive benchmarking, financial modelling, and stakeholder presentations. We look for students with strong project management skills, autonomy, and excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills. Strategy, data analysis, KPI tracking, and leadership experience are a plus.

title: Strategy & Corporate Development Intern
description: Support the Corporate Strategy team in identifying growth opportunities, performing market research and competitive analysis, and contributing to M&A screening. You will prepare strategic presentations for the Executive Committee. Required skills: strategy, financial analysis, Excel modelling, market research, PowerPoint. Strong analytical profile, project management experience, and bilingual French-English required.

title: M&A Analyst Intern
description: Work alongside M&A advisors on mid-cap transactions. Duties: financial modelling in Excel (DCF, LBO, comparables), due diligence, pitch book preparation, and sector research. You will present findings to deal teams and contribute to client deliverables. Required: financial analysis, corporate finance, Excel, PowerPoint, strategy, project management. English fluency essential. Previous finance internship or finance coursework required.

title: Corporate Finance Intern — Equity Research
description: 6-month equity research internship within a mid-size investment bank. You will conduct sector analysis, build financial models (DCF, trading comparables), write research notes, and present investment theses. Skills needed: financial analysis, Excel (advanced), corporate finance, strategy, market research, presentation skills. English fluency required. Strong academic background in finance or business.

title: Financial Analyst Intern — FP&A
description: Join the Finance Planning & Analysis team of an industrial group. Tasks include monthly financial reporting, budget vs. actual variance analysis, KPI dashboards in Excel, and project management of the annual planning cycle. Excel, financial analysis, project management, and attention to detail are essential. PowerPoint for executive presentations. Python or SQL a plus for data automation.

title: Private Equity Analyst Intern
description: Assist investment professionals on growth equity transactions. Responsibilities: company screening, financial modelling (Excel LBO/DCF), market research, due diligence analysis, and investment memo preparation. Strong knowledge of corporate finance, strategy, and financial analysis required. Leadership, project management, and Excel skills are critical. French and English required.

title: Business Development Intern — International Markets
description: Support our BD team in opening new markets across Europe and APAC. Key tasks: lead generation, B2B client outreach, market research, competitive analysis, and CRM management (Salesforce). You will present findings to the VP of Sales and help build the international expansion strategy. Required skills: business development, sales, B2B, market research, CRM, strategy, Excel. Negotiation and leadership skills are a plus. English and a third language appreciated.

title: Sales & Business Development Intern
description: Join our B2B SaaS sales team as a Business Development Representative. You will prospect new enterprise accounts, manage the CRM pipeline, conduct market research, and work alongside Account Executives on deal strategy. Excel reporting, KPI tracking, and sales skills required. Negotiation, leadership, and presentation skills appreciated. English fluency required.

title: Go-to-Market Strategy Intern
description: Help launch a new product in the European market. You will conduct market research and segmentation, define the go-to-market strategy, manage the project timeline, and coordinate with sales and marketing teams. Strong strategy, project management, and financial analysis skills required. Market research, Excel, PowerPoint, and leadership experience expected. Bilingual French/English.

title: Marketing Strategy Intern
description: Join the Brand Strategy team of a premium cosmetics company. Responsibilities: market research and competitive analysis, customer segmentation, campaign performance analysis in Excel, digital marketing reports, and supporting the product strategy roadmap. Strong market research, strategy, Excel, and presentation skills required. Google Analytics, data analysis, and content creation experience are a plus.

title: Brand Management Intern
description: Support the Brand Director of a luxury goods brand. Tasks include: coordinating product launches, market research, competitive benchmark, managing the content calendar, and preparing presentation decks. Skills: brand management, market research, project management, PowerPoint, Excel, digital marketing. Creativity and autonomy required. French and English required.

title: Digital Marketing & Analytics Intern
description: Data-driven marketing internship. You will manage paid campaigns (Google Ads, LinkedIn), analyse performance with Google Analytics and Excel, and produce KPI dashboards. Some Python scripting for automation would be appreciated but not required. SQL queries for CRM data. Market research, data analysis, content creation and digital marketing skills required. English fluency required.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Build dashboards and run analyses to support business decisions. Tools: Python (pandas), SQL, Power BI. Tasks: clean and transform transactional data, track sales KPIs, and present insights to category managers. Skills required: Python, SQL, data analysis, Excel, data visualization, statistics, Power BI. Previous internship or academic project in data analytics preferred.

title: Data Science Intern — Pricing & Demand
description: Apply machine learning to demand forecasting and dynamic pricing problems. You will work with Python (scikit-learn, pandas), SQL, and experiment on production data. Strong statistics, machine learning, Python, and data analysis skills required. Excel for reporting. Problem-solving mindset and autonomy required.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst Intern
description: Support the BI team in building reporting infrastructure for 10 business units. Tools: SQL, Power BI, Excel (advanced). Key tasks: write SQL queries, build Power BI dashboards, automate KPI reports, and present findings to senior management. SQL, data analysis, Power BI, Excel, and presentation skills required. Python a plus.

title: Strategy & Transformation Intern
description: 6-month internship in our strategy and digital transformation practice. You will support partners on client projects covering operational efficiency, digital strategy, and organisational design. Tasks: market research, financial analysis, Excel modelling, project management, and client presentation preparation. Strategy, financial analysis, project management, Excel, and leadership skills required. French and English required.

title: International Business Development Intern
description: London-based internship supporting export sales and market entry across Europe and Southeast Asia. Responsibilities: B2B client management, market research, competitive analysis, CRM tracking, and business development presentations. Skills: business development, strategy, market research, sales, B2B, Excel, negotiation. Leadership and project management a plus. Fluent English required; French or Mandarin appreciated.

title: Operations & Supply Chain Analyst Intern
description: Support the Supply Chain Director in process optimisation projects. Tasks: data analysis with Excel and SQL, project management, KPI reporting, and lean process improvement. Excel, data analysis, project management, financial analysis, and strategy required. Python or Power BI a plus.

title: Project Manager Intern — Digital Products
description: Assist the Product Management team on a portfolio of B2B SaaS products. Responsibilities: define and track project KPIs, coordinate cross-functional teams, run market research, write product specs, and facilitate stakeholder presentations. Skills: project management, strategy, Excel, KPI, leadership, and presentation. Agile methodology experience a plus.

title: Sustainability & ESG Strategy Intern
description: Support the ESG team in building the group sustainability strategy and reporting framework. Tasks: research and benchmarking, financial analysis of ESG impact, project management of reporting initiatives, and stakeholder presentations. Strategy, market research, financial analysis, project management, and Excel skills required. Interest in sustainability essential. English and French required.

title: Corporate Strategy Intern — APAC
description: Singapore-based strategy internship supporting the APAC regional director. You will conduct market research on emerging markets in South and Southeast Asia, build financial models in Excel, and prepare strategy presentations for the board. Skills: strategy, financial analysis, market research, Excel, PowerPoint, project management. English and French required; Mandarin a strong plus. International profile welcomed.

title: Investment Banking Summer Analyst
description: London IBD summer analyst programme, 3 months. Work on live M&A transactions and equity capital market deals. Tasks: financial modelling (DCF, LBO, trading comps), industry research, pitch book preparation. Corporate finance, financial analysis, Excel, strategy, and market research skills required. Presentation and leadership skills required. English fluency essential.

title: Junior Consultant — Young Talents Programme
description: We are looking for young, ambitious and dynamic candidates to join our Junior Consultant programme. The ideal candidate is a high-energy, driven self-starter who is competitive, assertive and results-oriented. French nationality preferred. Must be available full time 6 days a week. We offer an exciting environment for candidates aged 20-26. Strategy, Excel, market research, project management skills required.

title: International Trade Analyst Intern
description: Join our trading team to analyse international commodity markets and support the deal pipeline. Responsibilities include market research, financial analysis, Excel reporting, and strategy support. Strong analytical skills, autonomy, and project management required. KPI tracking, corporate finance, and negotiation skills are a plus. English and French fluency required.
